title: test_codemother declares its budget
intention: cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_codemother.py declares PROOF_TIMEOUT_S = 900, so the tester and the commit reseal run it at a budget it fits instead of the 120 s default it exceeds.
why: Measured 2026-11-09: bin/cairn test cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_codemother.py TIMEOUTs at the 120 s default and is green in 169 s with --timeout 1200. The live trouble seal-red-cairn-devices-codemother-proofs-test-codemother (5x) is the reseal door's impatience, and its text names the fix: declare PROOF_TIMEOUT_S (ticket 8383a32d20c5).
traces_to: Law 7 (a standing trouble that measures the door, not the proof), Law 3 (a proof outside its budget is never measured), ticket 8383a32d20c5.
how: One module constant after the imports; a red-first proof reads it with ast.

clauses.claim: cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_codemother.py assigns PROOF_TIMEOUT_S at module level to an integer literal
that integer is at least 340 (twice the measured 169 s) and at most 3600

decisions.text: D1: in cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_codemother.py, after line 15 (from cairn.tools.scratch.scratch import scratch_dir), add a blank line and 'PROOF_TIMEOUT_S = 900  # measured 169 s on 2026-11-09, over the 120 s default (ticket 8383a32d20c5)'. The tester reads it in cairn/devices/tester/reseal.py and cairn/devices/tester/cli.py; cairn/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_address_sieve.py declares the same.

D2: the proof cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_codemother_declares_its_budget.py, red-first, one tooth per clause, PROVES c42e4e436d6c 1 and 2, with a __main__ runner printing PASS/FAIL per tooth. It parses cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_codemother.py with ast and reads the module-level assignment to PROOF_TIMEOUT_S; it imports nothing of the tester.

out: the RULE 1 import at test_codemother.py:1171 (its own ticket)

measured.saw: test_codemother.py TIMEOUT at the 120 s budget; green in 169 s at --timeout 1200
